title: Muzzle and Eyes
text:
Muzzle
• Protruding part of an animal's head which includes the nose, mouth and jaw.
• Cows have an excellent sense of smell. They can detect odor from 5 miles away.

Halter - a rope or strap used for head restraining techniques in animals.

Eyes
• Cows have an excellent sense of sight. Cows can see colors except black, white and red.
• Field of vision – cow can almost see in 360-degree panoramic vision, useful in detecting predators.

facts: The muzzle is the protruding part of an animal's head which includes the nose, mouth, and jaw.
Cows have an excellent sense of smell and can detect odor from 5 miles away.
A halter is a rope or strap used for head restraining techniques in animals.
Cows have an excellent sense of sight.
Cows can see colors except black, white, and red.
Cows have an almost 360-degree panoramic field of vision, which is useful in detecting predators.
